patch_description: Keep radius multiplier 1.5 and default count four. Extend the prior three-particle branch from relative fitness drop ≤0.05 to ≤0.075, retaining the diameter threshold. This tests whether preserving an additional ordinary PSO particle helps broadly dispersed swarms after modest fitness deterioration. The original branch achieved mean error 3.75 versus 3.81 for constant count four; this threshold refinement remains unmeasured.
